description: Search the live web, fetch the top organic pages as clean Markdown, and return citation-ready numbered sources plus one token-bounded `context` string ready for an AI prompt. Use this when the goal is answering/researching, and use `search` when raw SERP structure or a specialized vertical is needed.

country.description: ISO country code for search and proxy geo

fetch_content.description: False returns snippet-only context without fetching result pages

max_tokens.description: Maximum estimated tokens in the assembled context (default 8000)

top_n.description: Top organic pages to fetch (default 3, max 5)

name: search_and_read
